# Open3DStream schema

`o3ds.fbs` is the FlatBuffers schema of [Open3DStream](https://github.com/mocap-ca/Open3DStream)
(MIT, see `LICENSE`), taken from commit `142f137e62450734274b0dd4fdb1501a21e1dafd` and
re-encoded from Windows-1252 to UTF-8. The build generates the C++ reader from it with `flatc`.
